title: 매입예정 삭제와 재등록 (거절 차 — ssancar 안 부름)

steps.text: 11가1103 삭제했습니다. 같은 차량번호로 다시 등록할 수 있습니다.

steps.db: select deleted_at from purchase_listings where vehicle_number = ? order by id desc limit 1
select count(*) as n from purchase_listings where vehicle_number = ? and deleted_at is null
select id from board_audit_logs where action = 'delete' and purchase_listing_id = (select max(id) from purchase_listings where vehicle_number = ?) and created_at >= ? limit 1
select count(*) as n from integration_events where target = 'ssancar_inspection' and purchase_listing_id = (select max(id) from purchase_listings where vehicle_number = ?) and created_at >= ?

steps.check: ERP 로 넘어간 차는 삭제 버튼 없음
